description: Call this to find versioned datasets by topic: AI provider incidents, MCP server liveness, SDK and tool releases, API latency and more. Returns each project's slug, title, access (public or paid), visibility, latest version and record count. query keeps the projects whose slug or title contains the word; left out, every project. Free, no key; your operator's private projects appear only with your key. Next: dataset_info with a slug for the readme and schema, read_dataset for its records. With an agent key, query_dataset runs SQL over a version.

query.description: a keyword: keeps projects whose slug or title contains it, up to 100 characters; left out, every project

name: list_datasets
title: List datasets
